# **ZSM CreateSMP**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## About this modpack:
This is a modpack i created with my friend for our survival roleplay server on create mod. I features over 120 different mods, so everyone will be able to find something for themself. Only version 4.1.9 and newer has it's own server file modpack. If you want to use it on your server, you have to use version 4.1.9 or newer.
## What it features:
- Create Mod and it's addons
- Aeronautics
- Economy (Create: Numismatics)
- Various optimalization mods
- Custom terrain generation (JJThunder)
- Roleplay clothes mods
## What is ZSM CreateSMP?
ZMS is a shortcut of _Zaawansowany Serwer Minecraft_ in Polish, which means Advanced Minecraft Server. ZMS CreateSMP is a modpack, I created to play with friends with popular Create mod and Aeronautics. If you want to experiance Fancy journey with your friends and unlimited possibilites of growth, then this modpack is for you. Build factories, create shops, cars, planes and much more!
### How to install on server:
Each version changelog after 4.1.9 contains link to .zip file containing every necessary server side mod.
### List of the mods:
List of the mods is still changing (We are adding and removing mods (most of them are create addons)). If you want to know what's new in the mod, then check each mod version changelog. Have fun and explore yourself all of the mods and decide what you want to do.
### Warning!
This modpack is still changing, so have in mind, that after some update, your world may have become corrupted because of change in the mods, so make backups before updating to newer versions.
